1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 e6 3.Nf3 c5 4.d5 exd5 5.cx.strategy: Recaptures towards the centre: White has a space-gaining pawn on d5 and a half-open c-file against the c5 pawn, while Black has the e-file and a queenside majority. Both sides get a clear plan: White presses in the centre, Black counterattacks on the wing.

Shields the c5 pawn, stops the d-pawn from advancing and frees the c8 bishop. Black commits to a firm pawn chain and gives up the idea of an early central break; the game is a manoeuvring fight against White's space.
